names.name: TTB
aliases: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau

text.what: The US Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau: it rules on AVA petitions, writes them into 27 CFR part 9, and approves every label that goes on a bottle.
text.how: An AVA petition has to show the name is already used for the place, propose a boundary, and show the growing conditions differ from the ground around it. Nothing in the rule speaks to quality.

kin.as: Established under its predecessor bureau in 1981.
And renamed by the TTB in 2005 after a trademark objection.
